title: Good-prime Hecke adjointness for the unnormalized Petersson integral
statement: Let M be a nonzero natural number and Γ=Γ₀(M). Let μ=dx dy/y² and P(f,g)(z)=conjugate(f(z))g(z)(Im z)². Suppose F⊂ℍ is measurable and, for μ-almost every z, there exists γ∈Γ with γz∈F such that every δ∈Γ satisfying δz∈F obeys δ=γ or δ=−γ. For every natural prime p not dividing M, every witnesses hp and hpM, and every f,g∈CuspForm Γ 2, the exact operator T=CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM satisfies ∫_F P(Tf,g)dμ=∫_F P(f,Tg)dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] (F : Set UpperHalfPlane), MeasurableSet F → (∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∃ γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, γ ∈ (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) ∧ γ • z ∈ F ∧ ∀ δ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, δ ∈ (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) → δ • z ∈ F → δ = γ ∨ δ = -γ) → ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpM : ¬ p ∣ M) (f g : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 M) 2), MeasureTheory.integral ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane).restrict F) (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM f) g) = MeasureTheory.integral ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane).restrict F) (UpperHalfPlane.petersson 2 f (CuspForm.heckeTLin 2 hp hpM g))
